propositions: A new [code_health] configuration section must be defined in _config_schema.py with typed fields: enabled (bool, default False), scan_roots (list[str]), analyzers (dict[str,str] for language-to-tool mapping), size_cap (int|None), and size_near_fraction (float).
The [code_health] section must support command-line override parsing via rebar -c code_health.<key>=<val> using the existing override mechanism.
The [code_health] section must be re-exported through config.py and included in the pinned surface guard tests/golden/config_surface.json.
This ticket defines schema and parsing only; runtime consumption of [code_health] config and fallback behavior on unconfigured clients are deferred to migration 0734.
The golden surface test tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py must pass after config_surface.json is regenerated to reflect the new section.
